# Teamcamp

An all-in-one project management tool designed for teams to efficiently manage projects, collaborate seamlessly, and streamline workflows.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/teamcamp/.

## Actions

- **Create Task**: Create a new task within a specified project.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a specific project by its id.
- **Get Project List** (read-only): Retrieve all projects within the workspace.
- **Get Task List** (read-only): Retrieve a list of tasks within a project.
